cards.name: Pollen-Shield Hare // Hare Raising
cards.oracleText:
Creature tokens you control get +1/+1.
Target creature you control gains vigilance and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.

cards.name: Hare Apparent
cards.oracleText:
When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
A deck can have any number of cards named Hare Apparent.
